parsed.notes: The patch removes the quoting around the URL argument passed to system(), which actually removes a protective measure against shell metacharacters. This does not mitigate the OS Command Injection issue and may increase its severity. The change is directly related to the finding, so it is not unnecessary. No additional distinct issues were introduced beyond the persistence of the original vulnerability.
